candidates.lead_note: BoiseDev (Apr 15, 2026): construction of a new building at 248 Caldwell Blvd, Nampa started Apr 20. The Pedraza family group also runs El Tenampa Meridian, two Metztli taquerias and the Colombia Event Center in Caldwell.

A BoiseDev 2026 bank expansion result says WaFd Bank recently opened on Milwaukee St, Boise, is building a branch at Eagle Rd and Ustick in Meridian, and plans another on Ten Mile Rd, Meridian. Check that this Jul 30 article is where that is stated. WaFd is a regional bank based in Seattle.

A Meridian Chamber Instagram post on Aug 12, 2026 celebrated the ribbon cutting of Rocket Express Car Wash. The car wash crew makes it a uniform candidate, but the subsegment fit is loose. Whether it is independent or a chain, and its address, need checking.

Club volleyball, baseball and softball organization (Facebook lists 1775 W State St Boise). Its 2026 to 27 volleyball season adds a new 12 week Idaho Show Volleyball Academy for 10U to 17U teams, and tryouts are at Boise High.

The Paylocity snippet shows Community Association Manager (Boise) and Assistant Maintenance Technician (Boise), both dated 09/08/2026. The Idaho office is at 2318 S Eagle Rd, Meridian (kppmidaho.com). Its site says AMI (Association Management Inc) is now Keystone, so this is an HOA management consolidation. The HQ is in California.

BoiseDev (Jun 12, 2026): a new indoor golf training facility at 535 N Locust Grove Rd, co-owned locally, with founding members at end of July and a grand opening in August 2026. It offers coaching, a golf fitness gym, junior programs and corporate memberships. The Tee Box brand also has a Utah site, so check franchise status.
